variant.description: Loading shape. Changing it while loading morphs the strokes into the new shape.

status.description: success folds the strokes into a check, error into a cross, loading gathers them back.

size.description: Rendered size in px. The drawing uses a 24 unit grid.

strokeWidth.description: Stroke thickness in grid units for ring, square, check, and cross.

tone.description: Colors the check with --success and the cross with --danger. Off keeps currentColor.

decorative.description: Drops the status role and text, for loaders inside a control that announces its own state.
